searchText: is an accounts balance stored in state? and can it be called to like values in a contracts state? account balance is stored in account trie (top level state trie) -- not sure what you mean "called to" thanks. i was reading this https://medium.com/@eiki1212/ethereum-state-trie-architecture-explained-a30237009d4e which suggests the account trie is specifically for contracts? is that wrong ? im trying to understand geth guts better so im going thru statedb.go and database.go, trying to parse out account balances directly for each block <:notlikethis:916566856746295338> The account trie has all accounts (addresses) in it. Contracts have a non-zero value hashed for the `codeHash` is all. `storageRoot` may also be an empty tree root for non-contracts as well. 🤔 It is the _account **storage** trie_ that the article is saying is relevant only to contracts. Which is a tree with a root inside the account trie. ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh ty for the emphasis do any of the storage hashes here match to like a blockhash? im trying to determine the block associated with a StateDB i was going to start just mashing shit together to pass the blocknum around but its gotta be in here somewhere (i assume) like originalRoot, expectedRoot, stateRoot This is a protocol R&D focused discord. I think you will have better luck getting these answers on the Geth discord - https://discord.com/invite/nthXNEv

excerpts.content: The account trie has all accounts (addresses) in it.  Contracts have a non-zero value hashed for the `codeHash` is all.

excerpts.content: `storageRoot` may also be an empty tree root for non-contracts as well.  🤔
